workouts.title: Metcon
workouts.description:
In 3min windows, complete the following

0-3 minutes
2 rounds
9 Cal Row
9 Thrusters 95/65 lbs

3-6 minutes
2 rounds
12 Cal Row
12 Thrusters 95/65 lbs

6-9 minutes
2 rounds
15 Cal Row
15 Thrusters 95/65 lbs

Continue to add 3 reps until you cannot make the 3min window.
